title: Old Village Stories
paragraphs: Saat badai besar sedang melanda desa itu malam itu, sebagian besar keluarga tetap berada di dalam rumah, mendengarkan angin yang semakin kencang dan memperhatikan listrik yang berkedip mati-hidup setiap beberapa menit.
Di luar, seorang tetangga sedang berjuang mengamankan atapnya saat badai berada di puncaknya, jadi dua pemuda dari ujung jalan bergegas membantunya, meski hujan membasahi pakaian mereka.

Di dalam masjid kecil, beberapa sesepuh berkumpul dengan tenang, karena bangunan itu selalu dianggap tempat berlindung paling aman saat badai seperti ini, tradisi yang diturunkan selama beberapa generasi.

Saat badai akhirnya mulai reda, semua orang kelelahan namun lega. Warga desa sudah membicarakan bagaimana mereka akan memperbaiki kerusakan bersama-sama keesokan paginya, seperti yang selalu mereka lakukan sebelumnya.
answerKey: While the grand storm was hitting the village that night, most families were staying inside, listening to the wind grow louder and watching the power flicker on and off every few minutes. Outside, one neighbor was struggling to secure his roof when the storm was at its worst, so two younger men from down the street were rushing over to help him, even as the rain was soaking through their clothes. Inside the small mosque, a few elders were gathering quietly, since the building had always been considered the safest shelter during storms like this one, a tradition passed down for generations. By the time the storm was finally passing, everyone was exhausted but relieved. The villagers were already discussing how they would repair the damage together the next morning, just as they always had before.
